description: LUNAR FRONTIER is a student-led team building a 3D lunar exploration and mission simulation game for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Players will explore the Moon, collect scientific samples, deploy research equipment, build a lunar outpost, manage power and life-support systems, conduct greenhouse experiments, and solve engineering challenges. We welcome teammates interested in Unreal Engine 5, C++, coding, 3D modelling, game design, UI/UX, science research, and storytelling.
